questions.question: Provide an overview of your company, including headcount and office locations. (Maximum 120 words)

preferred.question: Provide a brief overview of your company.
preferred.answer: Larkspur Data was founded in 2019 and provides a cloud customer-data platform for regulated industries. We have approximately 240 employees across offices in Denver, USA and Dublin, Ireland, and serve more than 120 customers in banking, insurance and healthcare.

traps.question: Tell us about your company, including size and locations.
traps.answer: Larkspur Data is a Denver-based software company founded in 2019. Our team of about 150 people builds a customer-data platform for financial institutions.

questions.question: Provide three references from US community banks, with contact names.
MANDATORY: Which single sign-on protocols and identity providers do you support?

preferred.question: Which single sign-on protocols and identity providers are supported?
preferred.answer: Larkspur supports single sign-on via SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect. SSO is tested with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace, and administrators can require SSO for every user in the organisation.

traps.question: Does the platform support single sign-on?
traps.answer: Yes, we support industry-standard single sign-on and can work with most identity providers.

questions.question: MANDATORY: How are user accounts created and removed automatically when staff join or leave?

preferred.question: Describe how user accounts are provisioned and de-provisioned automatically.
preferred.answer: Larkspur supports automatic provisioning and de-provisioning through SCIM 2.0 with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. Deactivating a user in the identity provider removes their Larkspur access within minutes, and group membership in the identity provider maps to Larkspur roles.

traps.question: How are user accounts created and removed?
traps.answer: User accounts are created by administrators in the Larkspur console, individually or by CSV upload. Automated provisioning is on our product roadmap.

questions.question: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for administrative users?

preferred.question: Is multi-factor authentication enforced for administrators?
preferred.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every administrative account. Administrators sign in through SSO with MFA enforced by the identity provider, or with Larkspur's built-in TOTP authenticator. Admin sessions expire after 8 hours of inactivity.

questions.question: List your current security certifications and attestations.

preferred.question: Which security certifications and attestations do you hold?
preferred.answer: Larkspur holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, available under NDA, and is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (certificate issued October 2025).

traps.question: List your current security certifications.
traps.answer: Larkspur holds a SOC 2 Type I report dated 30 June 2024. Our SOC 2 Type II audit period is under way, and ISO/IEC 27001 certification is planned.

questions.question: How often is your platform penetration tested, and by whom?

preferred.question: How often is the platform penetration tested, and by whom?
preferred.answer: Ironbridge Security, an independent CREST-accredited firm, performs a full penetration test of the platform at least once a year, and we run automated external vulnerability scans every quarter. The executive summary of the latest test is available under NDA.

traps.question: Describe your security testing practices.
traps.answer: We perform regular security testing of our platform and take security very seriously.

questions.question: How long are audit logs retained, and can we export them?

preferred.question: How long are audit logs retained?
preferred.answer: Audit logs of user and administrator activity are retained for 12 months and can be exported through our REST API.

traps.question: Do you keep audit logs?
traps.answer: Yes. Administrative actions are logged and retained for 90 days.

questions.question: Where will our data be stored?

preferred.question: Where will our data be hosted? Can it remain in the EU?
preferred.answer: Larkspur is hosted on AWS. Each customer chooses the US region (us-east-1) or the EU region (eu-central-1, Frankfurt). Customer data, backups and logs stay in the chosen region.

traps.question: Where is customer data stored?
traps.answer: All customer data is hosted on AWS in the us-east-1 region (Northern Virginia).

questions.question: What availability do you commit to, and what remedies apply if it is missed?

preferred.question: What uptime do you commit to, and what remedies apply if you miss it?
preferred.answer: Our SLA commits to 99.9% monthly uptime for the production platform. If we miss it, customers receive service credits of 10% of the monthly fee below 99.9% and 25% below 99.0%. Uptime is published on our status page at status.larkspurdata.example.

traps.question: State your availability commitment.
traps.answer: Larkspur commits to 99.5% monthly availability, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.

questions.question: Describe your support model, including response times for critical incidents.

preferred.question: Describe your support model, including hours and response times.
preferred.answer: Severity-1 incidents are handled 24/7 with an initial response within 30 minutes. Other issues are handled Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm in the customer's region, with a first response within 4 business hours. Customers reach us through the support portal or by email, and every account has a named customer success manager.

traps.question: How can we contact support?
traps.answer: Our friendly support team is always happy to help through our support portal.

questions.question: Describe your implementation approach and a typical timeline. (Maximum 150 words)

preferred.question: Describe your implementation approach and typical timeline.
preferred.answer: A typical implementation takes 6 to 8 weeks in four phases: discovery (weeks 1-2), configuration and data connection (weeks 3-5), user acceptance testing (week 6), and go-live with two weeks of hypercare (weeks 7-8). A dedicated Larkspur implementation manager leads the project throughout.

traps.question: How long does implementation take?
traps.answer: Implementations typically take 12 to 16 weeks depending on the number of data sources.

traps.question: Outline the onboarding process.
traps.answer: Every customer is different, so we agree the plan and timeline during kickoff.

questions.question: How will you migrate seven years of historical member data?

preferred.question: How do you migrate our historical data onto the platform?
preferred.answer: Historical data is loaded in bulk through our Amazon S3, Snowflake or BigQuery connectors. We reconcile row counts and checksums against the source before sign-off, and most customers load two to three years of history before go-live.

preferred.question: Is our data used to train AI models?
preferred.answer: No. Customer data is never used to train AI models, ours or any third party's. Larkspur's AI-assisted features are off by default, can be enabled per workspace, and process data only within the customer's chosen hosting region.

traps.question: Describe your approach to artificial intelligence.
traps.answer: We take responsible AI seriously and follow industry best practices.
